summary: Schneider National filed an 8-K announcing a quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share on Class A and B common stock, approved by its Board on April 29, 2026. The dividend is payable to holders of record as of June 12, 2026, and expected to be paid on July 10, 2026. This is a routine capital return event, not a special situation. No premium, price per share, or deal structure is involved. The filing is a standard dividend declaration with no strategic or structural complexity. Watch for consistent dividend policy as a signal of shareholder return commitment.
